title: feat(multiaxis): Multi-Axis Deburr - tilted chamfer-mill edge breaks with holder tilt-away
body:
## Second-review fixes (current round)

Final head: `fdb1630fef05fb9b46d20a1673e5e8540ae69a12`. These fixes answer the review on head `ebe55a46f`.

1. **Posted golden and the two rotary laws.** New suite `crates/app/tests/mcp_multiaxis_deburr_post.rs`. It posts three sections on the tilt head with the Fanuc post: an upright Deburr, the Multi-Axis Deburr, and an upright Deburr after it.
   - `the_three_section_tilthead_program_matches_its_golden` locks the program in `golden/nc/multiaxis_deburr_tilthead.nc`: retract, turn, approach, cut, retract, return.
   - `the_tilted_section_states_its_rotary_pose_before_its_first_tilted_feed` pins #3421. A rapid states A and B before the first tilted feed. The stated pose is the pose of that feed. No feed turns a rotary on the way in.
   - `the_upright_section_after_the_tilted_section_returns_the_rotaries_first` pins #3478. The tilted section ends leaned. The next section commands A0 and B0 after `G28`, before its first X/Y traverse.
   - The tilted window stops at Z 9 in this fixture. The top edges are outside it, so every pose leans and the section ends leaned. With the full window the last pose is upright, and the return law has nothing to test.
2. **The shank toggle.** The page no longer shows "Avoid shank collisions" for this kind. It shows a read-only row "Shank and holder guard: Always on" with a true hint. The `shank_avoid` field stays in the file and MCP grammar and has no effect. Decision: `docs/decisions/1894-multiaxis-deburr.md`. Pin: `egui_app::tests::ma_deburr_page::the_passes_tab_shows_the_shank_guard_as_always_on_with_no_switch`.
3. **The setup law on the page.** The Geometry tab shows one visible line: the stock must be the source model, and the setup can hold no other part. Pin: `egui_app::tests::ma_deburr_page::the_geometry_tab_states_the_stock_and_part_law`.
4. **One `Changelog:` line.** The body now has one line, at the end.
5. **`Axis4` posted.** `axis4_posts_with_the_a_axis_only` posts `Axis4` with a 60-degree cone on the tilt head. A turns on the top edges along X. B stays zero in the whole program.

Pin proof (each mutation was reverted after the run):

- `uprightAfterTilt()` in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` returns at once: the return pin and the golden go red.
- `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs` writes no angles on a leaned rapid: the pose pin, the return pin and the golden go red.
- `kernel_params` reads `Axis4` as `Axis5`: the `Axis4` test goes red. The post refuses the program first (a crossing finding), before the B check.
- The page source of `ebe55a46f`: both `ma_deburr_page` tests go red.

The branch merges `upstream/main` two times in this round, at `b5ef7c39e` and then `f35202134`. Both merges were clean, with no hand edits. The first merge brings the #3478 post fix that the return pin needs. The second brings main's fix of `mcp_setup_moves` (`1c6002baa`). That suite failed in the first gate run of this round, and it failed on main too (#3606).

Gates on the final head `fdb1630fe` (main merged at `f35202134`):

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 762 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 73.2 minutes. It includes `mcp_multiaxis_deburr` (9), `mcp_multiaxis_deburr_post` (4), `mcp_setup_moves`, `golden_cl`, `solid_law_goldens`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` and the UI library.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on `fdb1630fe` (run after the push, no new commit): 253 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, 35.6 minutes. Lanes `motion heavy` and `app heavy`; the four known-fail checks (#1950, #2849) were red as expected.
- Trial merge of `fdb1630fe` with main `1e7800a9e` (local, not pushed; clean, no hand edits): motion lib deburr tests 13, `mcp_multiaxis_deburr` 9, `mcp_multiaxis_deburr_post` 4, `operations` 121, `ribbon` 13 and the UI page tests 3 pass.
- Goldens: one new posted golden (see "Goldens moved"). No existing recorded program or catalog program changed.

## Stock safety fix (earlier round)

Final head: `ebe55a46f01c774fbdcdcdd49f05205cfb8ec550`.

Multi-Axis Deburr now requires the complete stock boundary to match the source mesh.
Generation and posting refuse missing, empty, non-finite or different stock by name.
The comparison sorts triangle vertices and triangles. It ignores ordering, normals and winding.
Equal bounds do not satisfy the check.

For matching stock, the existing source guard checks the cone, flute, shank and holder through the cut, entry and exit.
Generation also runs the shared `plunge_solid::audit_posed` check.
Posting reads the live stock before it accepts a cached path.
The refusal also applies to a safe different tessellation or stock removed by an earlier operation.
The column simulator still does not judge posed moves. The named refusal prevents an unproved stock verdict from permitting posting.

Pins in `mcp_multiaxis_deburr`:

- `multiaxis_deburr_refuses_stock_beside_the_vertical_edge`.
- `multiaxis_deburr_rechecks_stock_before_posting_the_cached_path`.
- `multiaxis_deburr_live_stock_judge_refuses_an_unjudged_cached_path`.

The clear controls first generate and post source-shaped stock.
The unsafe case adds 60 x 60 x 10 mm stock beside a 40 x 40 x 10 mm part.
The generation pin also sets `center_cutting=true` to isolate the complete-tool guard from the plunge check.
The cached-post pin checks the actual post command after a stock edit. Freshness refuses it and no NC file is written.
The direct live-judge pin checks the named stock refusal independently of freshness.

Pin proof:

- Removing only the generation stock guard makes `multiaxis_deburr_refuses_stock_beside_the_vertical_edge` fail. Generation returns `status: ok`.
- Removing only the live stock guard makes `multiaxis_deburr_live_stock_judge_refuses_an_unjudged_cached_path` fail. The judge returns `None`.
- Restoring both source files byte for byte makes all nine `mcp_multiaxis_deburr` tests pass.

`CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_multiaxis_deburr` passed all nine tests on the final head.

Final-head quick gate:

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 526 steps in 75.3 minutes.
The run had zero failures and zero stalls. It used the merged main revision `deb5364ee`.
Motion library: 551 passed, 10 ignored. App library: 297 passed.
UI library: 1434 passed, 8 ignored. MCP suite: nine passed.
`slot_dxf_sketch`: four passed. No reached golden changed.
The shared `upstream/main` reference advanced to `ef157211` during the run. The tested tree did not change.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed on the final head in 1 minute 31 seconds.

Final-head heavy gate:

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed all 244 steps in 58.4 minutes.
The reached lanes were `motion heavy` and `app heavy`. The run had zero failures and zero stalls.
All 108 ordinary ignored tests passed. All four known-fail checks matched their expected failures.
The heavy `example_catalog` suite passed all four tests.
The command used the current `upstream/main` reference after its advance to `ef157211`.
The tested head remained `ebe55a46f01c774fbdcdcdd49f05205cfb8ec550`.

Catalog and goldens on the final head:

- `app suites: example_catalog`: 37 passed, 4 ignored, zero failures.
- `app suites: example_catalog_adaptive`: one test passed.
- `app suites: example_catalog_edge_work`: one test passed.
- Goldens moved: none. The catalog suites ran. No recorded program changed in this fix.

The branch includes a clean merge of main as fetched at this round's start: `deb5364ee`.
No conflict required a hand edit. `PROCESS_VERSION` comes from main.
The new exhaustive `pick_kinds` match receives the same `NotTaken(PICK_OWED)` arm as Deburr.
This merge compatibility fix permits the requested current-main build.
This round changes no UI. The existing screenshots still show the current controls.


The earlier sections below record their stated heads. Their validation does not replace this round's validation.

## Separate-part safety fix (earlier round)

Head: `91a03dd8c9d000effb3f4510bd325495a6d22d05`.

Multi-Axis Deburr now refuses by name when another kept part exists. Generation collects the other parts through the shared keep law. Posting checks the live parts before it accepts a cached path. The other parts receive no chamfer exemption. Edge selection stays on the source. This conservative refusal also applies to distant kept parts.

Pins in `mcp_multiaxis_deburr`:
- `multiaxis_deburr_refuses_regeneration_with_a_separate_kept_part`.
- `multiaxis_deburr_rechecks_a_separate_part_before_posting_the_cached_path`.

Each pin uses the review's separate cube and first generates and posts the clear source. The suite passed 6/6. Removing the generation guard, the live posting guard, or the keep-law entry failed the corresponding pins. Each restored source passed. Removing the keep-law entry reproduced the unsafe cached post.

Final-head validation:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 515/516 passed. Only the previously reported stale Slot golden failed in `slot_dxf_sketch::a_slot_outline_seeds_the_slot_and_cuts_it_to_size`. No golden changed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 242/242 passed. Reached lanes: `motion heavy` and `app heavy`. All 102 ordinary ignored tests passed. All six expected-failure checks matched.

## What changed

- A new operation kind, **Multi-Axis Deburr** (`OpType::MultiAxisDeburr`), is appended at ordinal 46 in `Section::MultiAxis`. Stored kind ids do not move.
- It has every field of the 3D Deburr and five more: `axis_mode` (`Axis5` / `Axis4`), `lead_deg`, `lag_deg`, `max_tilt_deg` and `shank_avoid`.
- New kernel `camcraft_motion::multiaxis::multiaxis_deburr` (`deburr_axis.rs`, `deburr_pose.rs`):
  - The tool lays one cone flank on the chamfer plane of each break. The cut is the flat chamfer for every pose that turns the axis about the plane normal.
  - `Axis5` leans the axis inside `max_tilt_deg`. `Axis4` keeps the axis square to the A axis (about X).
  - Mandatory continuous facet checks cover the full cone and the supplied physical shank and holder. They cover each complete cut, entry and exit. The stored `shank_avoid` option cannot disable this guard.
  - An edge with no clear pose follows the Deburr's unreachable-edge policy: skip with a note, or refuse by name.
  - The tool enters and leaves along a checked, bounded axis line. The entire cone stays above `bottom_z`. Pose changes, gaps and chamfer-plane corners split runs.
  - Each run declares a framed flat `EdgeBreak` cap (#1891).
- The exposed-edge scan moved from `finishing3d/deburr.rs` into the shared `finishing3d/deburr_scan.rs`. The 3D Deburr calls it in the same order.
- App wiring: kind row, seed, sanity door (lead minus lag inside the cap), generate arm, cache stamp, project DTO (`multi_axis_deburr`), heights, setup sheet, section mode, WCS refusals, sim break bound.
- MCP: `add_operation`, `edit_operation` and `set_operation_geometry` work with the new kind through the generic tools.
- UI: `multiaxis_deburr_page.rs` (Geometry: size, filters, unreachable policy; Passes: axis mode, lean, max tilt, shank avoid; Heights; Feeds). The kind has its own original glyph (`assets/ui/svg/op-multiaxis-deburr.svg`, PNG from `cargo xtask icons`).

## Cause

New feature (#1894). A vertical cone cannot break steep or vertical edges, so the 3D Deburr skips them.

## Safety review fixes on the new head

Final head: `a312b20ebdb48c2505ec417c6008d5cc1c6569d4`.

- Each candidate trims the edge until the tip and the lowest cone-rim point stay at or above `bottom_z` on every pass.
- Continuous outer convex polyhedra enclose the cone and the physical tool bands along the entire cutting segment.
- Facet clipping permits cone and cutting-flute contact only within the finite requested chamfer prism. Floors, other faces and material past an edge end receive no exemption.
- The same continuous checks cover the complete entry and exit lines. Clearance endpoints must put the whole tool above the part. The first plunge stages the axis change above every part face plus the largest tool radius and 1 mm.
- An axis that is too flat or requires more than 100 tool diameters of reach is refused. Unsafe segments use the existing named skip or refuse policy.
- The app supplies the physical shank and holder even when `shank_avoid` is false. The kernel guards the operation because column stock simulation does not judge posed cuts.

Regression pins:

- `the_brick_keeps_the_tilted_tip_and_entire_cone_above_the_bottom`: complete cone and tip stay above the brick's programmed bottom; clear vertical edges still cut.
- `a_raised_bottom_clips_the_cone_without_a_part_floor_to_hide_the_error`: a raised window isolates the bottom guard from the part floor.
- `a_boss_on_a_floor_skips_the_unsafe_foot_and_still_cuts_the_clear_edge`: the window extends below the floor; the unsafe foot is skipped and the clear upper edge still cuts.
- `an_obstacle_on_the_entry_line_is_skipped_while_clear_edges_still_cut`: an obstacle away from the cut blocks the entry or exit; other edges still cut.
- `an_unsafe_entry_refuses_by_name_when_skipping_is_disabled`: the picked edge cuts without the obstacle and refuses with the obstacle.
- `disabling_shank_avoid_cannot_bypass_the_mandatory_holder_collision_guard`: the option is off; an obstacle that misses the cone and shank still blocks the holder.

Mutation checks (each restored byte for byte):

- Ignored the pose offset in bottom clipping: the raised-window pin failed with a cone below `bottom_z`. Restored: passed.
- Disabled cone facet checks: the boss-floor pin failed with a cone in the floor. Restored: passed.
- Checked only the cut and omitted the entry/exit sweeps: the entry-obstacle pin failed when the tip crossed the obstacle. Restored: passed.
- Omitted the physical shank and holder from the app adapter: the option-off holder pin failed. Restored: passed.
- Sent the first plunge directly to the tip: the existing MCP generation pin failed with two mid-turn shank findings. Restored: passed.

Validation:

- Full quick gate on predecessor `93e571af99028af87a1dbdcf00cae796d57fa628`: 515 of 516 steps passed in 36.5 minutes. Only `slot_dxf_sketch::a_slot_outline_seeds_the_slot_and_cuts_it_to_size` failed at its existing stale golden. The Slot test and golden are unchanged by this fix.
- The final commit removes one redundant `let` binding. It does not change the guarded geometry or the tests.
- Final-head quick selection: `motion suites: lib` and `app suites: mcp_multiaxis_deburr` passed both steps in 1.9 minutes. Motion: 530 passed, 10 ignored. MCP: 4 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed on the exact final source tree.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed all 242 steps on the final head in 40.9 minutes. The reached lanes were `motion heavy` and `app heavy`. All 102 ordinary ignored tests passed. All six registered known-fail checks matched their expected failures.
- All 13 `multiaxis::deburr_axis_tests` passed in release mode on the final head. This includes all five new kernel safety pins.

The recorded gate runs used `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1`. An earlier run with incompatible build artifacts was excluded. No golden, screenshot, log or review image is part of these fix commits.

The earlier checks below apply only to their stated original head. They do not replace the final validation above.

## Not exercised

- The column stock sim does not model posed moves. It says so by name (`not_judged`).
